pairs: quam vidit super Judam et Jerusalem,
which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem,
and a donkey knows the manger of his lord,
but Israel has not known me,
and my people have not understood.
They have blasphemed the Holy One of Israel.
For what reason shall I continue to strike you,
and the entire heart is grieving.
A planta pedis usque ad verticem,
From the sole of the foot, even to the top of the head,
vulnus, et livor, et plaga tumens,
Wounds and bruises and swelling sores:
Your cities have been set ablaze.
regionem vestram coram vobis alieni devorant,
Foreigners devour your countryside in your sight,
et desolabitur sicut in vastitate hostili.
and it will become desolate, as if devastated by enemies.
Et derelinquetur filia Sion ut umbraculum in vinea,
And the daughter of Zion will be left behind, like an arbor in a vineyard,
and like a shelter in a cucumber field,
and like a city being laid to waste.
Nisi Dominus exercituum reliquisset nobis semen,
If the Lord of hosts had not bequeathed us offspring,
we would have been like Sodom,
and we would have been comparable to Gomorrah.
Listen to the Word of the Lord,
you leaders of the people of Sodom.
Listen closely to the law of our God,
I do not desire holocausts of rams,
et sanguinem vitulorum et agnorum et hircorum,
nor the blood of calves and of lambs and of he-goats.
When you approach before my sight,
quis quæsivit hæc de manibus vestris,
who is it that requires these things from your hands,
so that you would walk in my courts?
You should no longer offer sacrifice in vain.
Incense is an abomination to me.
Neomeniam et sabbatum, et festivitates alias,
The new moons and the Sabbaths and the other feast days,
My soul hates your days of proclamation
et solemnitates vestras odivit anima mea:
They have become bothersome to me.
And so, when you extend your hands,
I will avert my eyes from you.
And when you multiply your prayers,
non exaudiam: manus enim vestræ sanguine plenæ sunt.
I will not heed you. For your hands are full of blood.
auferte malum cogitationum vestrarum ab oculis meis:
take away the evil of your intentions from my eyes.
And then approach and accuse me,
Si fuerint peccata vestra ut coccinum,
if your sins are like scarlet,
they shall be made white like snow;
et si fuerint rubra quasi vermiculus,
and if they are red like vermillion,
they shall become white like wool.
then you will eat the good things of the land.
But if you are not willing,
and you provoke me to anger,
then the sword will devour you.
For the mouth of the Lord has spoken.
Quomodo facta est meretrix civitas fidelis,
How has the faithful city, full of judgment,
Argentum tuum versum est in scoriam;
Your silver has turned into dross.
Your wine has been mixed with water.
They do not judge for orphans,
et causa viduæ non ingreditur ad illos.
and the widow’s case is not brought before them.
Propter hoc ait Dominus, Deus exercituum,
Because of this, the Lord God of hosts,
Ah! I will be consoled over my enemies,
and I will be vindicated from my adversaries.
Et convertam manum meam ad te,
And I will turn my hand to you.
et excoquam ad puram scoriam tuam,
And I will temper your dross unto purity,
and I will take away all your tin.
Et restituam judices tuos ut fuerunt prius,
And I will restore your judges, so that they will be as before,
and your counselors as in times long past. After this,
you shall be called the City of the Just,
Zion will be redeemed in judgment,
and they will lead her back to justice.
And he shall crush the accursed
And those who have abandoned the Lord will be consumed.
Confundentur enim ab idolis quibus sacrificaverunt,
For they shall be confounded because of the idols, to which they have sacrificed.
et erubescetis super hortis quos elegeratis,
And you shall be ashamed over the gardens that you chose,
cum fueritis velut quercus defluentibus foliis,
when you were like an oak with falling leaves,
and like a garden without water.
Et erit fortitudo vestra ut favilla stuppæ,
And your strength will be like the embers from stubble,
and your work will be like a spark,
and there will be no one to extinguish it.
